title: Refactor SQL Queries
problem_statement: SQL queries are constructed using string concatenation, leading to potential SQL injection vulnerabilities.
risk_if_unaddressed: High risk of data breaches and unauthorized data access.
suggested_approach: Use parameterized queries or ORM for database interactions.
success_criteria: No direct string concatenation in SQL query construction.

provenance.evidence: SQL = "SELECT * FROM Customers WHERE ID = " & customerId
